claim: The Windows v1.014 Welly-o-meter normalizes raw DropPower to a maximum value of 0x69 (105).

sources.observation: Welly routine around VA 0x40768B-0x4078D7 stores the meter counter into DropPower, compares the rising counter against 0x69, and on the alternate direction adds half the counter before storing it.

tests: engine/tests/recovered_math_tests.cpp: kDropPowerMax and full-power launch arithmetic
notes: The complete user-facing two-click state/timing mapping is not yet promoted; only the raw normalized cap is.
